description: This PHP source file defines the class 'GenericRestController' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class extends 'AbstractRestController' and manages REST API requests for resources, supporting operations like GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE. It handles the initialization of API endpoints, validation, and response preparation, supporting both collection and resource endpoints.

classes.name: GenericRestController
classes.description: A REST controller managing resource operations such as retrieval, creation, update, and deletion via API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the API endpoint object based on request attributes, ensuring it is a ResourceEndpoint or CollectionEndpoint.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Handles GET requests, retrieving one or all resources depending on the request.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for GET requests based on whether it's a single resource or collection request.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new resources, restricted to collection endpoints.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for creating resources.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing resources.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for updating resources.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete resources.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Sets validation rules for deleting resources.

methods.name: getNotInstanceOfException
methods.description: Generates an exception when an endpoint does not match the expected interface.

methods.name: isGetOneRequest
methods.description: Determines if the request is for a single resource based on request attributes.

methods.name: getPreparedResponseParamsFromResult
methods.description: Prepares response parameters from the endpoint result object, including meta and relationship data.
